newsitem.title: USA: Duke Realty developing three properties.
newsitem.headline: Duke Realty developing three properties.

text.p: Duke Realty Investments Inc said Thursday that it has three new developments underway, with a combined investment of $34.6 million.

The developments include a 577,000 square foot distribution facility at Lebanon Business Park in Indianapolis, a 145,000 square food suburban office building at The Corporate Park at Tuttle Crossing in Columbus, Ohio, and a 76,000 square foot suburban office building at Governor's Point development in Cincinnati.
The three developments are 72 percent pre-leased in total, said Duke Realty, a self-administered real estate investment trust.
